reviews.text: Very professional and detailed exams of both my cats. Thanks!
Such amazing care, environment and staff.
Awesome vet. Very thorough, accommodating, hospitable! Definitely recommend. It’s the little things that count and WVet does those little things well.
Thank you so much to the staff but specially the vet he took the time and effort to help my dog sweetpea  i highly recommend him

We needed health certificates for both Great Britain and the European Union and the timing for both was very specific. Dr Rizzi expertly handle our dog and the paperwork as well as answering all my questions along the way.
Everything worked as designed for our travel to multiple countries.

Customer Service Complaint – Unacceptable Phone Experience

I am giving this establishment a one-star rating specifically because of the extremely unprofessional and disrespectful customer service I received over the phone from an employee named Jonathan.

I called with an important question and was repeatedly interrupted before I was even given the opportunity to explain what I needed. Jonathan repeatedly answered questions I had not yet asked, rather than allowing me to finish speaking and understand my concern. I politely asked him several times to please stop interrupting me and allow me to ask my question, but he continued to disregard my request.

The situation became even more unacceptable when, instead of addressing my concern or allowing me to finish, he abruptly told me to have a good day and hung up the phone on me.

This is completely unacceptable customer service, particularly for an establishment where customers are spending significant amounts of money. I have personally spent over $1,000 with this establishment, which makes this experience even more disappointing.

I am submitting this complaint because I believe management or the owner should be made aware of how customers are being treated when they call. Answering the phone is a direct point of contact with customers, and basic professionalism, patience, and the ability to listen should be expected.

I am currently awaiting important results, which makes this matter particularly important to me. I sincerely hope management takes this complaint seriously, addresses the situation appropriately with the employee involved, and ensures that other customers do not have a similar experience.

I would appreciate having my concerns acknowledged and addressed. I hope that my future interactions with the establishment will reflect the level of professionalism and customer service that paying customers should reasonably expect.
We love it here! It’s quite hard to find a vet that handles cat really well and this is our favorite in the neighborhood 💕 we’ve been coming here the past few years and going strong!

Their staff is amazing, the place is friendly for animals and humans. Nothing in particular to post about right now. They have just been so great, easy to get in contact with (text, phone or email) for questions, advice, records etc I figured people should know that read these reviews. I highly recommend them to all my existing and future pup parents.

My partner and I have been bringing our two cats, Kitters and Big Papa, here for almost 6 years now. The front desk is always incredibly accomodating when it comes to scheduling appointments and always takes the time to welcome us in. I cannot thank them enough for squeezing one of the cats in MULTIPLE TIMES for emergencies!!

All of the staff here is amazing and knowledgeable. Special shoutout to Dr. Glenn who has been taking care of our IBD/hyperthyroid kitty on the left (Kitters) for years who always takes her time to answer any questions we have or provide reassurance. Dr. Chen recently took amazing care of both her and her brother as well. Everyone is so kind here and we always feel welcome and reassured. We recommend WVC to all of our friends with pets!
